forecast_rate_semantics.DD: derived from sampled game stat lines and inclusive of triple doubles
forecast_rate_semantics.POINTS_40_PLUS: derived from sampled points and inclusive of 50-plus games

strategy_principles: Use a shared policy manager across isolated draft strategies.
Draft and policy decisions receive forecast distributions; realized future games are never exposed before completion.
Score fixed weekly starter assignments with one immutable lock per starter slot and no bench swapping.
Report hindsight upper bound separately from ordinary policy results.
evidence_limitations: All player pools, schedules, forecast models, outcomes, opponent noise, and structural shifts are synthetic.
One IR slot is confirmed by the user's settings screenshot; IR transactions are not modeled.
Replacement-aware estimates native-position undrafted alternatives using market-order depletion; this is not an observed waiver pool.
Market-aware timing compares current plus next-own-pick Lock-In value under market-order opponent depletion; this is not observed live behavior.
The study is a bounded sensitivity comparison, not calibrated player projections or win probabilities.
